title: Families
hint: Every family using the app. You see counts only, never amounts or entries.

newHint: The admin signs in with this email, chooses their own password, then writes their name and picks the family's currencies. The family name is already filled in. If they don't sign in within 24 hours, the login is deleted and you can start it again.
passwordHint: At least 6 letters or digits. Send it to them privately; they replace it the first time they sign in.
